#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>

using namespace std;

bool match(const string& s, long long n) {
    int len = s.length();
    vector<int> digits(len);
    long long temp = n;
    for (int i = len - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        digits[i] = temp % 10;
        temp /= 10;
    }
    if (len > 1 && digits[0] == 0) return false;
    int x = -1;
    for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
        int d = digits[i];
        char pc = s[i];
        if (pc == 'X') {
            if (x >= 0 && x != d) return false;
            x = d;
        } else if (pc != '_') {
            if (pc - '0' != d) return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

int main() {
    string s;
    cin >> s;
    int len = s.length();
    long long end = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
        end *= 10;
    }
    int res = 0;
    for (long long i = 0; i < end; i++) {
        if (i % 25 == 0 && match(s, i)) {
            res++;
        }
    }
    cout << res << endl;
    return 0;
}
